summary: Iteration 218 - Batch 5 Keyless Competitor Parity Features (4 of 30 P0 gaps) tested. context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 218 adds 4 keyless competitor-parity features (Batch 5 of 30 P0 gaps): (1) Travel Agent B2B Portal at /api/agents/* with CRUD, negotiated rates (discount %), book-on-behalf (commission calculation), commission report. (2) Door-Lock Audit Log at /api/door-locks/log POST and /api/door-locks/{property_id}/log GET with filters (days/room/method/result), returns items + denied_count + master_key_uses. (3) Owner Portal at /api/owner-portal/{owner_id}/properties and /summary - resolves via owner_ids array OR owner_id field. (4) Direct Widget Savings Banner at /api/widget/savings-banner (PUBLIC) - falls back to undercut_pct from parity_defender_config. Frontend panels: AgentsB2BPanel (Agents tab + Commission report tab, New agent modal), SecurityOwnerPanel (Door-lock audit tab + Owner portal tab). Sidebar buttons: b2b-agents-btn, security-owner-btn. After this: 23/30 P0 done.
